literal: Five senses attained even when, benefit is not indeed, truth knowledge to those who lack.
translation: Even if one has attained mastery over the five senses, there is no benefit to those who lack the realization of truth.
modern: ஐம்புலன்களையும் அடக்கியாளும் திறனை அடைந்திருந்தாலும், உண்மையை உணரும் அறிவு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு அதனால் எந்தப் பயனும் இல்லை.
explanation: The couplet contrasts the mastery of the physical senses with the realization of ultimate truth. The phrase 'ஐயுணர்வு' refers to the perception or mastery of the five senses, while 'மெய்யுணர்வு' denotes the knowledge of true reality. The text states that even if a person has successfully attained control over their five senses, this achievement yields no real benefit if they still lack the understanding of truth. Thus, sensory discipline is shown to be incomplete without the deeper realization of reality.
